aws-compliance.control.cloudfront_distri.reason: The query requires CertificateSource=cloudfront and MinimumProtocolVersion=TLSv1.2_2021 simultaneously. AWS documents that a CloudFront default certificate always sets the policy to TLSv1 regardless of requested setting, so the source has no passing valid default-certificate configuration and incorrectly excludes custom ACM certificates. No implementation gap is classified as rejection.
